title: A family run's link refusal is tested at the module file and holds for a dangling child-directory link
outcome: A family run's link refusal is tested at the module file and holds for a dangling child-directory link
acceptance: A family whose child directory is a dangling link is refused by its family run rather than read as having no child directory, matching the documented rule that a link at a family's module file or child directory fails the check
A source-size test fixture links a family's module file, and the family run refuses it as a link naming that file, so removing the module-file link check fails a test

completion.summary: Refused dangling family child-directory links and added exact-path regressions for split/unsplit child links and module-file links; full Windows gate, Codex/Claude review pair, fresh 2/2 independent acceptance and all-store readiness passed.
